item.title: Women who were passed over – Prussia
item.description: The Kingdom of Prussia existed from 1701 to 1918, and it operated under the principle of salic law, which barred women from the throne entirely. item.title: Princess Xian – The tribal Chieftain who made a peaceful relationship with the Sui Dynasty
item.description: Princess Xian was a tribal chieftain of the Li tribe in Southern China. She was a loyal supporter of the Chen Dynasty.
